verses.original: μου Τεκνία γράφω ταῦτα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ ἔχομεν Παράκλητον πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον
verses.transliteration: mou Teknia graphō tauta hymin hina mē hamartēte kai ean tis hamartē echomen Paraklēton pros ton Patera Iēsoun Christon dikaion
verses.literal: My little children I am writing these things to you so that vvv you will not sin [But] if anyone does sin we have an advocate before the Father Jesus Christ [the] Righteous [One]

verses.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐστιν ἱλασμός περὶ ἡμῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν δὲ οὐ μόνον περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τοῦ ὅλου κόσμου
verses.transliteration: kai autos estin hilasmos peri hēmōn tōn hamartiōn de ou monon peri tōn hēmeterōn alla kai peri tou holou kosmou
verses.literal: - He Himself is [the] atoning sacrifice for our - sins and not only for - ours but also for the [sins] of [the] whole world

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν ἐὰν τηρῶμεν αὐτοῦ τὰς ἐντολὰς
verses.transliteration: Kai en toutō ginōskomen hoti egnōkamen auton ean tērōmen autou tas entolas
verses.literal: - By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him if we keep His - commandments

verses.original: ὁ λέγων ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτόν καὶ μὴ τηρῶν αὐτοῦ τὰς ἐντολὰς ἐστίν ψεύστης καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἔστιν οὐκ ἐν τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: ho legōn hoti Egnōka auton kai mē tērōn autou tas entolas estin pseustēs kai hē alētheia estin ouk en toutō
verses.literal: If anyone says - I know Him [but] vvv does not keep His - commandments he is a liar and the truth is not in him

verses.original: δ’ ὃς ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ τετελείωται ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσμεν ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: d’ hos an tērē autou ton logon hē agapē tou Theou teteleiōtai alēthōs en toutō En toutō ginōskomen hoti esmen en autō
verses.literal: But if anyone . . . keeps His - word the love - of God has been truly perfected . . . in him By this we know that we are in Him

verses.original: ὁ λέγων μένειν ἐν αὐτῷ ὀφείλει καὶ περιεπάτησεν καθὼς οὕτως ἐκεῖνος αὐτὸς περιπατεῖν
verses.transliteration: ho legōn menein en autō opheilei kai periepatēsen kathōs houtōs ekeinos autos peripatein
verses.literal: Whoever claims to abide in Him must - walk as . . . [Jesus] . . . walked

verses.original: Ἀγαπητοί οὐκ γράφω ὑμῖν καινὴν ἐντολὴν ἀλλ’ παλαιὰν ἐντολὴν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ἡ ἡ παλαιά ἐντολὴ ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ἠκούσατε
verses.transliteration: Agapētoi ouk graphō hymin kainēn entolēn all’ palaian entolēn hēn eichete ap’ archēs hē hē palaia entolē estin ho logos hon ēkousate
verses.literal: Beloved vvv I am not writing to you a new commandment but an old [one] which you have had from [the] beginning [This] . . . . . . commandment is the message - you have heard

verses.original: πάλιν γράφω ὑμῖν καινὴν ἐντολὴν ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ τὸ ἀληθινὸν φῶς ἤδη φαίνει
verses.transliteration: palin graphō hymin kainēn entolēn ho estin alēthes en autō kai en hymin hoti hē skotia paragetai kai to to alēthinon phōs ēdē phainei
verses.literal: Then again I am also writing to you a new commandment which is true in Him and also in you For the darkness is fading and the - true light is already shining

verses.original: Ὁ λέγων εἶναι ἐν τῷ φωτὶ καὶ μισῶν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Ho legōn einai en tō phōti kai misōn autou ton adelphon estin heōs arti en tē skotia
verses.literal: If anyone claims to be in the light [but] hates his - brother he is still . . . in the darkness

verses.original: ὁ ἀγαπῶν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν μένει ἐν τῷ φωτὶ καὶ ἔστιν οὐκ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ho agapōn autou ton adelphon menei en tō phōti kai estin ouk skandalon en autō
verses.literal: Whoever loves his - brother remains in the light and there is no cause of stumbling in him

verses.original: δὲ ὁ μισῶν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ καὶ περιπατεῖ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς
verses.transliteration: de ho misōn autou ton adelphon estin en tē skotia kai peripatei en tē skotia kai ouk oiden pou hypagei hoti hē skotia etyphlōsen autou tous ophthalmous
verses.literal: But whoever hates his - brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness - vvv He does not know where he is going because the darkness has blinded his - eyes

verses.original: Γράφω ὑμῖν τεκνία ὅτι αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν διὰ αὐτοῦ τὸ ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: Graphō hymin teknia hoti hai hamartiai apheōntai hymin dia autou to onoma
verses.literal: I am writing to you little children because [your] sins have been forgiven . . . through His - name

verses.original: Γράφω ὑμῖν πατέρες ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς Γράφω ὑμῖν νεανίσκοι ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν παιδία ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: Graphō hymin pateres hoti egnōkate ton ap’ archēs Graphō hymin neaniskoi hoti nenikēkate ton ponēron Egrapsa hymin paidia hoti egnōkate ton Patera
verses.literal: I am writing to you fathers because you know Him who [is] from [the] beginning I am writing to you young men because you have overcome the evil [one] I have written to you children because you know the Father

verses.original: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν πατέρες ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν νεανίσκοι ὅτι ἐστε ἰσχυροί καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν
verses.transliteration: Egrapsa hymin pateres hoti egnōkate ton ap’ archēs Egrapsa hymin neaniskoi hoti este ischyroi kai ho logos tou Theou menei en hymin kai nenikēkate ton ponēron
verses.literal: I have written to you fathers because you know Him who [is] from [the] beginning I have written to you young men because you are strong and the word - of God abides in you and you have overcome the evil [one]

verses.original: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Πατρὸς ἔστιν οὐκ ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Mē agapate ton kosmon mēde ta en tō kosmō ean tis agapa ton kosmon hē agapē tou Patros estin ouk en autō
verses.literal: {Do} not love the world [or] anything in the world If anyone loves the world the love of the Father is not in him

verses.original: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονεία τοῦ βίου ἔστιν οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ πατρός ἀλλὰ ἐστίν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: hoti pan to en tō kosmō hē epithymia tēs sarkos kai hē epithymia tōn ophthalmōn kai hē alazoneia tou biou estin ouk ek tou patros alla estin ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: For all that [is] in the world the desires of the flesh - the desires of the eyes and the pride of life is not from the Father but - from the world

verses.original: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ αὐτοῦ ἡ ἐπιθυμία δὲ ὁ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: kai ho kosmos paragetai kai autou hē epithymia de ho poiōn to thelēma tou Theou menei eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: - The world is passing away [along with] its - desires but whoever does the will - of God remains vvv vvv forever

verses.original: Παιδία ἐστίν ἐσχάτη ὥρα καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται καὶ νῦν πολλοὶ ἀντίχριστοι γεγόνασιν ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐστίν ἐσχάτη ὥρα
verses.transliteration: Paidia estin eschatē hōra kai kathōs ēkousate hoti antichristos erchetai kai nyn polloi antichristoi gegonasin hothen ginōskomen hoti estin eschatē hōra
verses.literal: Children it is [the] last hour and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming so now many antichrists have appeared This is how we know - it is [the] last hour

verses.original: ἐξῆλθαν ἐξ ἡμῶν ἀλλ’ ἦσαν οὐκ ἐξ ἡμῶν γὰρ εἰ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν ἂν μεμενήκεισαν μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἀλλ’ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι πάντες οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐξ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: exēlthan ex hēmōn all’ ēsan ouk ex hēmōn gar ei ēsan ex hēmōn an memenēkeisan meth’ hēmōn all’ hina phanerōthōsin hoti pantes ouk eisin ex hēmōn
verses.literal: They went out from us but they did not belong . . . . . . to us For if they had belonged to us vvv they would have remained with us But [their departure] made it clear that vvv none of them belonged to . . . us

verses.original: ὑμεῖς Καὶ ἔχετε χρῖσμα ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ οἴδατε πάντες
verses.transliteration: hymeis Kai echete chrisma apo tou Hagiou kai oidate pantes
verses.literal: You however have [an] anointing from the Holy [One] and all of you know the truth . . .

verses.original: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἀλλ’ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν καὶ ὅτι οὐκ πᾶν ψεῦδος ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: ouk egrapsa hymin hoti ouk oidate tēn alētheian all’ hoti oidate autēn kai hoti ouk pan pseudos estin ek tēs alētheias
verses.literal: vvv I have not written to you because vvv you lack knowledge of the truth but because you have it and because no - lie comes from the truth

verses.original: Τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ οὐκ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἔστιν ὁ Χριστός οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὸν Υἱόν
verses.transliteration: Tis estin ho pseustēs ei mē ouk ho arnoumenos hoti Iēsous estin ho Christos houtos estin ho antichristos ho arnoumenos ton Patera kai ton Huion
verses.literal: Who is the liar if [it is] not . . . the [one who] denies that Jesus is the Christ This is the antichrist who denies the Father and the Son

verses.original: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν Υἱὸν οὐδὲ ἔχει τὸν Πατέρα ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει τὸν Πατέρα καὶ
verses.transliteration: pas ho arnoumenos ton Huion oude echei ton Patera ho homologōn ton Huion echei ton Patera kai
verses.literal: Whoever . . . denies the Son vvv does not have the Father [but] whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς μενέτω ἐν ὑμῖν ἐὰν ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς μείνῃ ἐν ὑμῖν ὑμεῖς καὶ μενεῖτε ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis ho ēkousate ap’ archēs menetō en hymin ean ho ēkousate ap’ archēs meinē en hymin hymeis kai meneite en tō Huiō kai en tō Patri
verses.literal: [As for] you {let} what you have heard from [the] beginning remain in you If [it] . . . . . . . . . [does] . . . . . . you vvv will also remain in the Son and in the Father

verses.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν τὴν αἰώνιον τὴν ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: kai hautē estin hē epangelia hēn autos epēngeilato hēmin tēn aiōnion tēn zōēn
verses.literal: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us - eternal - life

verses.original: ἔγραψα Ταῦτα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: egrapsa Tauta hymin peri tōn planōntōn hymas
verses.literal: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μένει ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ἔχετε οὐ χρείαν ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς ἀλλ’ ὡς τὸ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐστιν ἀληθές καὶ ἔστιν οὐκ ψεῦδος χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων καὶ μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ καθὼς ὑμᾶς ἐδίδαξεν
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis to chrisma ho elabete ap’ autou menei en hymin kai echete ou chreian hina tis didaskē hymas all’ hōs to autou kai estin alēthes kai estin ouk pseudos chrisma didaskei hymas peri pantōn kai menete en autō kathōs hymas edidaxen
verses.literal: And [as for] you the anointing - you received from Him remains in you and you do not need - anyone to teach you But just as vvv [His] - - true and - vvv genuine anointing teaches you about all things [so] remain in Him as you have been taught

verses.original: Καὶ νῦν τεκνία μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ ἵνα ἐὰν φανερωθῇ σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ παρουσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai nyn teknia menete en autō hina ean phanerōthē schōmen parrēsian kai mē aischynthōmen ap’ autou en autou tē parousia
verses.literal: And now little children remain in [Christ] so that when He appears we may be confident and vvv unashamed before Him at His - coming

verses.original: Ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι ἐστιν δίκαιός γινώσκετε καὶ ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην γεγέννηται ἐξ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ean eidēte hoti estin dikaios ginōskete kai hoti pas ho poiōn tēn dikaiosynēn gegennētai ex autou
verses.literal: If you know that He is righteous you also know . . . that everyone who practices - righteousness has been born of Him
